region: Eagle Ford / South Texas study bounding box; not a geological basin boundary
source_strength_assumption: Annual estimated gas volume spread uniformly over the year unless an explicit alternative is configured; hourly operation is not observed.
unavailable_measured_inputs: pipeline capacity and permission to connect

alternatives.sentinel3_cds: Not downloaded; authenticated access not established; not a dependency of this bundle
alternatives.rrc_lease_volume_join: Not established; not needed for satellite-volume scenario

source_warning: World Bank annual data is VIIRS-derived. This replaces the difficult raw feed, not the sensor.
external_runtime_dependencies: Analytical fixtures can run locally. Current demo still fetches basemap tiles/fonts; offline analytical data does not make the whole website offline.
population_allocation_default: 5 km cells weighted by intersected tract area, conserving each tract total; modeled uniform distribution
